title: New `updateId` for Hosted App Responses
summary: The `UpdateAppStoreHostedAppResponse` now includes an `updateId` to uniquely identify and track specific versions of hosted app updates, enabling correlation with publishing signals.
details: The `UpdateAppStoreHostedAppResponse` schema has been extended with a new `updateId` property of type `string`. This identifier is designed to provide a unique reference for each hosted app update submission, allowing developers to more effectively correlate their app updates with publishing signals, such as those returned by `ListHostedAppsPublishingSignals`.
